note: D9 starting spec for pour tea, written in tokens to mirror manip_sim/pour_stages.py: the carry holds teapot.up_axis to world.z (tight) with translation free (the path holds from the lifted entry, so no band there); the carry goal puts the spout tip centered (moderate) over the opening at clearance large / slack snug, the same band as the pour path, so the hand-off lies inside the pour's path; the pour tips teapot.front_axis to mug.-up (tight), a sweep about the teapot's lateral axis, with the spout tip held over the opening

emissions.name: grasp the teapot by its handle
emissions.verify: The gripper is closed on the handle with the grasp point at teapot.handle_center; the teapot is still upright at its spawn pose.
emissions.goal: The gripper closes on the teapot's handle at teapot.handle_center, with the teapot still upright at its spawn pose.

emissions.name: carry the teapot upright over the mug
emissions.verify: Along the carry teapot.+up stays vertical (no spill) with translation free; at the goal teapot.spout_tip sits centered over mug.opening_center at a large standoff above the rim, so the pot body and table are collision-free and the pour stage can start its tilt from this height.
emissions.goal: teapot.spout_tip ends up centered over mug.opening_center and lifted well above the rim, so the whole pot body clears the mug, with teapot.+up still pointing the way world.z points.

emissions.name: tilt the teapot to pour into the mug
emissions.verify: The teapot tilts about its lateral axis, spout first, until teapot.+front points the way mug.-up points; teapot.spout_tip stays over mug.opening_center, inside the rim, throughout the tilt.
emissions.goal: The teapot tips forward about its lateral (tilt) axis until teapot.+front, the spout direction, points the way mug.-up points, with teapot.spout_tip held centered above mug.opening_center so the tea falls into the mug.
